limitations: Embedded images keep a single .md self-contained, but third-party previewers that disable data URIs will not show them.
DOCX export is best-effort fidelity, not lossless: on the real 2,844-formula notebook 138 formulas (~4.8%) keep their LaTeX source with explicit warnings; content is never dropped.
Pandoc 3.11 DOCX/HTML same-condition comparison is recorded; strict xelatex PDF failed with exit 43 near source line 903, so no PDF speed comparison is claimed.
